REMARKS: Heights are geoid-referenced as the source dataset publishes them (VERTICAL_DATUM GEOID); no geoid-to-ellipsoid conversion is applied at this parity floor. A consumer rendering them as above-ellipsoid accepts a bounded (<~100 m) vertical offset.
